indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX settlements_merchant_status_idx ON revale.settlements USING btree (merchant_id, status, period_end DESC)

indexes.name: settlements_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX settlements_pkey ON revale.settlements USING btree (id)

indexes.name: transaction_events_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX transaction_events_pkey ON revale.transaction_events USING btree (id)

indexes.name: transactions_account_created_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX transactions_account_created_idx ON revale.transactions USING btree (account_id, created_at DESC) WHERE (account_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: transactions_external_transaction_id_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX transactions_external_transaction_id_key ON revale.transactions USING btree (external_transaction_id)

indexes.name: transactions_person_created_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX transactions_person_created_idx ON revale.transactions USING btree (person_id, created_at DESC) WHERE (person_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: transactions_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX transactions_pkey ON revale.transactions USING btree (id)

indexes.name: transactions_public_token_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX transactions_public_token_key ON revale.transactions USING btree (public_token)

indexes.name: treasury_bank_accounts_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX treasury_bank_accounts_pkey ON revale.treasury_bank_accounts USING btree (id)

indexes.name: treasury_bank_accounts_primary_unique
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX treasury_bank_accounts_primary_unique ON revale.treasury_bank_accounts USING btree (purpose, currency) WHERE ((active = true) AND (is_primary = true))

indexes.name: treasury_bank_accounts_purpose_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX treasury_bank_accounts_purpose_idx ON revale.treasury_bank_accounts USING btree (purpose, active)

indexes.name: treasury_bank_balance_snapshots_latest_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX treasury_bank_balance_snapshots_latest_idx ON revale.treasury_bank_balance_snapshots USING btree (bank_account_id, as_of DESC)

indexes.name: treasury_bank_balance_snapshots_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX treasury_bank_balance_snapshots_pkey ON revale.treasury_bank_balance_snapshots USING btree (id)

indexes.name: treasury_internal_transfers_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX treasury_internal_transfers_pkey ON revale.treasury_internal_transfers USING btree (id)

indexes.name: treasury_internal_transfers_ref_unique
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX treasury_internal_transfers_ref_unique ON revale.treasury_internal_transfers USING btree (bank_reference, bank_posted_on) WHERE (status = 'confirmed'::text)

indexes.name: uq_ledger_tx_type
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_ledger_tx_type ON revale.ledger_entries USING btree (transaction_id, entry_type) WHERE (transaction_id IS NOT NULL)
